title: 执行 Agent 提交整图修订候选

kind.description: patch: a necessary canvas diff after reviewing the whole workflow. unchanged: the current canvas already satisfies the request. needs_plan: satisfying it requires changing the plan or removing the initiating node; explain without changing the canvas.

summary.description: Explain the result and any remaining limitation in the user's language.
The effect of this request on this step, and why it changes or remains valid. An impact explanation, not a claim of machine verification.

review.description: Exactly one impact explanation for every step in the current plan, including steps whose nodes do not change.

upsertNodes.description: Only new or changed nodes. Each is a complete replacement, including its existing plan step. Keep existing names and confirmed settings unless the request requires a change.

removeNodes.description: Existing nodes no longer needed. Never remove the initiating target node.

addEdges.description: Only edges to add to the current canvas.

removeEdges.description: Only current edges to remove, identified by from, to, and output when present.

name.description: Canvas identity and visible label. Reuse the name of a node being changed.

step.description: An existing plan step ref. A revision can affect any existing step, not just the initiating step.

type.description: A type from the node table.

params.description: The complete set of explicit slot values; use only slots defined by this node type.

blanks.description: Defined slots still requiring values from the user; preserve values already confirmed.

note.description: A concise explanation of the choice that is not already visible in the slot values.

output.description: Required for a source with multiple outputs, such as condition's true/false. Omit for a single-output source.
